title: HitRects v1
description: Sent by the strip webview to the core when interactive objects move (SPEC 6.2, 6.3). The core makes the strip click-through everywhere except inside these rectangles (cursor polling against them on macOS and Windows, an input shape on Linux). The core needs geometry only; kind and agent are optional diagnostics. Each message replaces the previous set entirely; an empty rects list makes the whole strip click-through.

surface.description: Only the strip is partly click-through in v0.1; ambient and popover capture all input.

viewport.description: The webview's content size in logical (CSS) pixels when the rects were measured.

scale.description: The webview's devicePixelRatio, so the core can detect a scale mismatch with its window.

ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC), always an integer. The range (2000-01-01 to 2100-01-01) rejects a seconds value passed by mistake.

instance.description: Salted hash of a session or thread id, never the raw id: 32 lowercase hex characters. A raw UUID cannot match this pattern.

rect.description: Logical (CSS) pixels, origin at the top-left of the webview content area. Producers keep each rect inside the viewport.

agent.description: Snapshot agent id when the rect is a resident or its card.
